name: veilkit
description: Fast, validated PII / PHI / secret redaction in WebAssembly. Pattern + checksum, not ML.
author: Carlos Pichardo

scripts.build:wasm: cd ../crates/veilkit-wasm && wasm-pack build --release --target nodejs --out-dir ../../npm/pkg/node --out-name veilkit && wasm-pack build --release --target bundler --out-dir ../../npm/pkg/bundler --out-name veilkit && rm -f ../../npm/pkg/node/.gitignore ../../npm/pkg/bundler/.gitignore
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts
